## Notes

ST Nucleo-F767ZI (STM32F767ZI, Cortex-M7F, 384 KiB sram0) on Zephyr 3.7. Renode twin booted the C talker over serial (USART3, the ST-LINK VCP) and ethernet (phase-524 W1). Its RAM budget, `max_large_subscribers = 0`, is the descriptor's `[knobs.zenoh]`, which every image inherits (issue 2194); the ethernet image's extra knobs are its own (see the descriptor header).

See [Board Support Levels](../board-support-levels.md) for what each status means.
